title: How Coronavirus Kills: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) & COVID 19 Treatment
summary: A pulmonologist and critical care physician explains how COVID-19 can lead to pneumonia and acute respiratory distress syndrome. He covers evidence-based ARDS treatments such as low tidal volume ventilation.
why: In early 2020 HN commenters linked it as a clear explanation of how the virus kills through lung failure and why ventilator choices matter, notably in ventilator design threads.

quote.text: explaining how the virus eventually kills by causing failure of the lungs
